raw_proposal.draft:
Dear [Customer Name],

Thank you for reaching out to Cedar Systems. We understand that your construction services team is facing challenges with disconnected teams and are looking for workflow coordination and account reporting solutions. We are pleased to arrange a discovery meeting to better understand your specific requirements and how we can support your needs.

Please let us know a convenient time for the meeting, and we will be in touch shortly.

Best regards,
[Your Name]
Cedar Systems Team
[Contact Information]
questions: What is the preferred time for the discovery meeting?
Are there any specific teams or departments that should be included in the meeting?
uncertainties: The customer has not provided a budget approval yet, which may impact the timeline or scope of the discovery meeting.
